name: EDIA: Dados Alqueva (level and volume of Alqueva)
owner: EDIA, Empresa de Desenvolvimento e Infra-estruturas do Alqueva, S.A.
gives: level and stored volume of the Alqueva reservoir (Alentejo and Guadiana, not an Algarve dam)

why.basis: robots.txt (200, read 2026-11-18). The page /DadosAlqueva/ is not under /publico/, so it is disallowed. Main site https://www.edia.pt/robots.txt allows all ('Disallow:' empty) but links to the sigims page.

interface: ArcGIS JavaScript viewer (esri js 3.8), not a data feed; no API seen.
notes: GAP. Disallowed by robots. Honest note: I fetched the viewer's index.html once (7 KB, just the HTML shell, in the same command that read robots.txt, so before reading the rule); I read no data from it and deleted the copy. Not to be read again. EDIA also publishes news about Alqueva at https://www.edia.pt/pt/ (robots allows), but a news item is not a series.
